command.description: Absolute path to cmd or the name of a command that can run in the default shell.

description.description: Short description of what the program does

currentDir.description: Current directory where the command executes

hotkeyNumber.description: From 1-9, pressing alt+shift+hotkeyNumber will set the cmd as active.

placeholderText.description: Input placeholder text. Useful for differentiating between different commands.

noOutputTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds until the no output message is shown. Helps to prevent display flashing.  May need to be adjusted depending on how fast the command runs.

runOnEnter.description: Whether to run only on enter. If false (the default) the command will be run on every key stroke. **Note!**: To activate a result if runOnEnter is true, press cmd/ctrl + enter  (vs just enter when runOnEnter is false).

mode.description: Shows item in a list with arrow keys to change selection and enter to activate.

parseAnsiColors.description: Whether to parse ansii colors (nb: color might not be accurate)

stderrFilterRegex.description: Regex pattern to filter out matching stderr lines. Lines matching this pattern will be hidden.

maxLineLength.description: Displays only this many characters plus per item.

lineSplitter.description: Character(s) to split the output into lines.  Defaults to newlines.

lineSplitterRegex.description: Regular expression to split the output into lines as an array where the first item is the regex body and the second is the flags.

hideCount.description: Hides the number of lines received in the top left of the tray / panel under the input box

displayOptions.description: Display options. Use {} for default options.

mode.description: For non-list type output (e.g. JSON responses).

parseAnsiColors.description: Whether to parse ansii colors (nb: color might not be accurate)

stderrFilterRegex.description: Regex pattern to filter out matching stderr lines. Lines matching this pattern will be hidden.

sizeBreakPoint.description: Outputs under this size are shown using large size; over using small.

largeSize.description: Font size when output length < sizeBreakPoint. Any valid int or float.

smallSize.description: Output string length > sizeBreakPoint. Any valid tailwind font size.

jsonPath.description: Json path to the data you want in the form: levelOne.levelTwo.levelThree.

mode.description: For LLM output with markdown rendering and thinking block support.

parseAnsiColors.description: Whether to parse ansii colors (nb: color might not be accurate)

stderrFilterRegex.description: Regex pattern to filter out matching stderr lines. Lines matching this pattern will be hidden.

sizeBreakPoint.description: Output length threshold for font size switching.

thinkingDisplay.description:
How to handle thinking blocks.
- "none": Render as-is (no special handling)
- "keepHidden": Show "🧠 thinking... <count>" while thinking, disappear when normal tokens arrive
- "showWhileThinking": Show thinking content greyed/italic, disappear when normal tokens arrive
- "show": Show thinking greyed/italic AND normal tokens

thinkingOpenPattern.description: Regex pattern to match opening thinking tag.

thinkingClosePattern.description: Regex pattern to match closing thinking tag.

displayOptions.description: Display options. Use {} for default options.

activateAction.description:
Enter / double click action for a List item. Useful for opening or copying some text  to the clipboard. By default it copies. If:
- no extractor: Will copy / open entire line.
- extrator: Will copy / open match.
- extractor + extractorGroup: Will copy / open specific match group.

extractorRegexBody.description: Regex to extract text from each split line for use in the enterAction in this config. Don't pre/post-fix with /.

extractorFlags.description: Regex flags to extract text from each split line for use in the enterAction in this config. Must have set extractorRegex. Don't pre/post-fix with /.

extractorGroup.description: Regex group to extract text from each split line for use in the enterAction in this config. Must have set extractorRegex. Don't pre/post-fix with /.

isPath.description: Enables Control or Cmd (on mac) + O to open containing folder. This will get the parent  folder of the extracted text or error if the extract text is not a path.

hideOnActivation.description: Hide window after activation (copy, open, or reveal).
